_comment: COPY THIS FILE TO statements.local.json AND FILL IT IN. That path is gitignored — real statements are private financial records and must never be committed. Run: STATEMENTS=1 npx vitest run src/statement-validation.test.ts --disable-console-intercept
_lines_comment: One entry per line on the statement. `category` must be one of the engine's canonical SPEND_CATEGORIES, or null when you cannot honestly map it (a fee, a refund, a cash advance, an unrecognisable merchant). DO NOT guess a category to make the totals tie — unmapped spend is excluded from the prediction and reported, which is the point.

lines.note: a fee, not spend — earns nothing and must not enter the profile
merchant unrecognisable from the statement line

_truth_comment: THE GROUND TRUTH. Read it off the statement; never infer it. Give actualRewardUnits (points/miles credited) when the statement shows units — that comparison isolates the EARN model from the point valuation. Give actualRewardAed when the statement only shows a cashback figure in AED; that tests the earn model and the valuation table together and is flagged as such. Give both when the statement shows both.

_comment: A second cycle on the same card is worth more than one cycle on two cards — it tests the model against a different spend mix with the same known reward structure.
